azure-openai-api.policies_xml: <policies><inbound><llm-token-limit counter-key="@(context.Subscription.Id)" tokens-per-minute="300" estimate-prompt-tokens="false" remaining-tokens-header-name="x-apim-remaining-tokens" tokens-consumed-header-name="x-apim-tokens-consumed" /><llm-emit-token-metric namespace="ai-usage"><dimension name="Subscription ID" /><dimension name="API ID" /></llm-emit-token-metric></inbound><backend /><outbound /><on-error /></policies>
